milestones.title: Owner decision on a source host in Canada

remediation: The repository, pull requests, workflow definitions and job dispatch stay on github.com; npm ci reaches HQ's npm registry and runners reach GitHub's published ranges. Decide on a source host and CI control plane at HQ, after its own research and fit check.
title: Source code and the CI control plane stay on GitHub (US) after the runner move, and two network paths remain
